title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 54
paragraphs: Thus I have traced the descent according to the account given by the Hellenes; but according to the story as told by the Persians, Perseus himself was an Assyrian and became a Hellene, whereas the ancestors of Perseus were not Hellenes. As for the ancestors of Acrisius—who according to this account were not related to Perseus at all—they say that these were, as the Hellenes also report, Egyptians.
